defect_mapping.summary: The preflight transport classifier counted only HTTP 200 events, so Safe mode could issue an exact-endpoint request returning 204 and Local Actions could observe a valid 200 plus an alternate-status duplicate without failing.
defect_mapping.regression_test: Focused adversarial fixtures reject all 33 challenge mutations plus Response URL/status forgery: request-only, 204, encoded/extra-query, localhost and healthz variants; exact or semantic duplicates; wrong methods; shallow clones, mismatched/duplicated/impostor identities; redirects on all pairing/preflight exchanges; wrong Origin/CORS; invalid ordering; missing contract/UI proof; and every invalid terminal or unrelated-failure state. Two real Chrome exact-package previews and the full 346-test local gate passed during remediation; final independent challenge returned GO. Clean native GitHub assurance remains required.
